text: VERIFIED FIXED in tree (worker4, 2026-09-09): authorize_decapsulation at rust/lichen-gateway/src/tunnel_auth.rs:398-449 gathers ALL matching candidates, selects longest prefix_len with LRU tiebreak (entry.used < best_entry.used), then checks expiry on the selected candidate only — exact Python max(candidates, key=prefixlen) parity per the comment at :401-405. Both requested tests exist: tunnel_auth_vectors.rs:380 longer_live_prefix_authorizes_when_earlier_shorter_entry_is_expired and :392 expired_longest_prefix_denies_without_falling_back_to_shorter_live_grant. Not claiming (one-P2-per-round rule) — safe to close on this evidence.
